notes.title: Patch # 3
notes.notes:
Hi

For this week's patch I made these fixes and changes:

- Changed filter of resolutions to show those with height >= 720 instead of 900 (this should stop the bug where the list of resolutions appears empty, if not please let me know).
- Fixed a bug where the resolution list showed a resolution different from the one selected.
- Added an extra evaluation of achievements Rise, Alchemist and Archmage when loading a game (in case they didn't trigger properly).
- Fixed a bug where random encounters in the Sunken Temple caused an error.
- Fixed a bug where healing actions from monsters would give them XP even if they have reached level cap.
- Changed resolution mode in Main Menu, Intro and Ending to be proportional to the size of the screen (please let me know if you have any issue like text outside of the bounds of the screen).
- Added Credits screen.

That would be all for the moment. Please let me know if you find any problems.

Regards,
Jorge


EDIT 2017-10-19: made a small patch (not worthy of a new announcement IMO) to fix an issue with the Archmage achievement (look for a missing spell in the Volcanic Cavern).

notes.title: Patch # 2
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27209378/a3ece5a8a221f955a4c9cec2d05d1c1ea94f545f.gif

Hi

For this week's patch I made the following fixes and changes:

- Added an option to "Rest" during exploration (button in the bottom bar). This option allows you to restore your mana but if there's monsters roaming there's a chance that an encounter will be triggered. I added this option after hearing feedback that people wanted more options to recover mana. This option is not available in all areas (ex: Nusquam). Please let me know what you think.

https://i.imgur.com/uL3um5V.jpg

-  Fixed a bug that stopped the Full Screen option from updating properly in the Options menu.
- Added an option to delete save files in the Load and Save Game screens.
- Fixed a bug where a few ruins in Temple Island were floating.
- Fixed a bug where a location in Forgotten Pass was marked in the map as saying "To Cursed Tower" instead of "To Forest Ruins".
- Fixed a bug where the achievement Rise was not getting triggered.
- Added a small tooltip that shows capture chances when you are using a crystal in a wild monster.

https://i.imgur.com/Pb0dJyc.jpg

- Now the Luck stat will increase capture chances.
- Fixed a bug where the Magic stat was less powerful than expected (now it affects power of spells, potions and bombs properly).
- Added category (common, rare, legendary) to Monster screens in Bestiary, combat and capture.
- Added passive effects to list of skills in Monster screens in Bestiary.

There's a few more things that I wanted to add to this patch but time was running out so I'll add them in the next  patch (hopefully next week).

As you can see with this patch I'm reading your feedback and working on it so feel free to talk to me in the forums.

Regards,
Jorge

notes.title: Hotfix!
notes.notes:
This is just a small patch that I had to upload quickly to solve two issues that could ruin player's experience:

- Made another way to get in the church's basement. This is necessary in case you don't start Diomedes sidequest before he leaves the tavern ([spoiler]once you start the Elemental Locks Quest you'll be able to ask the sacristan for a key if you still don't have it[/spoiler]).

- The chances of spawning a monster (Gargoyle) in certain areas were too low making it very dificult to complete the collection so I increased them.


I have another "real" patch planned for this week. I'm reading your feedback and I plan to do something about many of your requests like another way of restoring mana (I'm thinking of adding an option to rest in the field with a % chance to trigger combat) and more UI data (show type of monster, passive abilities, chance of capture, etc.). Of course, I'll be making bug fixes too.

Please feel free to share your feedback and ideas in the forums so I can consider them in future patches.

Regards,
Jorge

notes.title: Patch # 1 live!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27209378/26edb0d7f3167d793f28be80e63332bca990ac11.gif

Hi

For this 1st patch I made these changes:

- Fixed a bug where some monsters would load incorrect stats and level after being summoned from the reserve.
- Fixed a bug where in some cases changing resolution and fullscreen wouldn't change after clicking Apply in the Options menu.
- Added sound of death to a few monsters that didn't have it.
- Changed hit effect in "Porcupine" special move (from Viverrus monster).
- Added a pair of missing spellbooks.
- Now pressing the hotkey for a panel will also close it (for ex: I for Inventory).

If you have technical issues please share them in the forums so I can look for a solution if possible.

By the way, currently Steam is experiencing technical problems (slow downloads). This is not specific to this game, it's happening to several games in different regions and is up to Steam to fix it (I say this because I know someone already refunded the game because of this).

I'm also reading your feedback about the gameplay so I can consider it in future patches (I'll make something about the mana mechanics) and hopefully I'll have a Linux version soon.

That would be all for the moment.

Regards,
Jorge

notes.title: Beastmancer release date set: October 5, 2017
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27209378/26edb0d7f3167d793f28be80e63332bca990ac11.gif

Hi

After a year and a half of development I'm finally ready to set a launch date for Beastmancer: October 5.

I want to apologize for the multiple delays, being honest I thought after my first game I was ready to do anything so I underestimated the scope of this project. RPGs (even those that lack a long and complex story) are always a challenge and in this case I didn't want to compromise and start cutting too many secondary features so I took the risk of investing more months in the game.

Hopefully you enjoy the game but even if you don't please share your feedback in the forums. I'll be working hard during the first months after launch.

Regards,
Jorge
